verdict.rationale: Intel's spec page documents only peak boost ('up to 5.70 GHz') and cache, while independent reviews corroborate strong multi-core productivity performance: faster than the 14900K and roughly matching or trailing the 9950X. Phoronix's Linux review saw occasional compiler segfaults with DDR5-6000/8000 memory, resolved at the rated DDR5-6400, and launch-period crash and consistency fixes are also reported. Missing for 10: documented core/thread counts, detailed boost behavior (per-core or all-core clocks), concrete compile-time or multi-core benchmark figures.
